acceptanceCovered: T2.1: App boots with embedded ActiveMQ broker; JmsTemplate + Queue beans available (spring.activemq.broker-url=vm://localhost?broker.persistent=false) — verified: BookingToursApplicationTests context loads, embedded broker start line in test log

T2.2: Flyway V7 migration creates notifications table with user_id FK, type, title, message, is_read columns; Notification entity + NotificationRepository + NotificationDto wired — verified: V7__create_notifications_table.sql present; Notification entity, NotificationRepository, NotificationDto compile clean

T2.3: BookingNotificationProducer.sendNotification() sends object message to booking.notifications queue via JmsTemplate — verified: BookingNotificationProducer.sendNotification calls jmsTemplate.convertAndSend(BOOKING_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE, msg)

T2.4: BookingNotificationConsumer @JmsListener receives message and persists via NotificationService.saveNotification() — verified: @JmsListener(destination=BOOKING_NOTIFICATIONS_QUEUE) on onMessage(); delegates to notificationService.saveNotification()

T2.5: adminConfirmBooking sends BOOKING_CONFIRMED; adminCancelBooking sends BOOKING_CANCELLED — each inserts exactly one notifications row for the booking's user — verified: sendBookingNotification helper called after save in both methods; uses findByIdWithTourAndUser to avoid LazyInit

T2.6: RabbitMQ fanout exchange tour.promotions + tour.promo.notification.queue + tour.promo.log.queue declared; app boots connected to RabbitMQ broker — verified: RabbitMQConfig declares FanoutExchange, 2 Queues, 2 Bindings; test profile disables listeners auto-startup

T2.7: TourPromotionPublisher.publishNewTour() sends TourPromotionMessage as JSON to tour.promotions fanout exchange — verified: rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(TOUR_PROMOTIONS_EXCHANGE, "", msg) with Jackson2JsonMessageConverter

T2.8: TourPromotionNotificationListener calls broadcastTourPromotion() inserting N notifications rows (one per active user); TourPromotionLogListener logs INFO — verified: @RabbitListener(PROMO_NOTIFICATION_QUEUE) → broadcastTourPromotion; @RabbitListener(PROMO_LOG_QUEUE) → log.info
T2.9: TourServiceImpl.create()/update() publish tour-promotion message when saved tour status is ACTIVE — verified: publishIfActive helper called after save in both create() and update()
regressionChecked: BookingServiceImpl adminConfirmBooking/adminCancelBooking: existing confirm/cancel logic unchanged — messaging is additive after save
TourServiceImpl create/update: existing validation unchanged — publish call is additive after save
BookingToursApplicationTests context load: passes with embedded ActiveMQ + RabbitMQ listener auto-startup=false
Flyway migration sequence: V6 = seed_admin_user (existing), V7 = notifications table (new) — no version gap

findings.summary: C1: adminConfirmBooking/adminCancelBooking used findById then accessed lazy booking.getUser()/getTour() in sendBookingNotification — LazyInitializationException risk. Fixed: replaced with findByIdWithTourAndUser (eager fetch).
C2: application-prod.properties had no broker config — prod boot would fail if AMQP/JMS starters present. Fixed: added env-var-backed ActiveMQ + RabbitMQ blocks.
C3: setTrustAllPackages(true) allowed deserialization of any class via JMS — security risk. Fixed: replaced with setTrustedPackages(List.of(messaging.activemq, entity packages)).
M1: @Modifying on markAllReadByUserId lacked clearAutomatically=true — stale L1 cache after bulk update. Fixed: added clearAutomatically=true.
M2: Test ActiveMQ URL was vm://localhost without broker.persistent=false — could leave disk residue. Fixed: added broker.persistent=false query param.
